record.bible_text: Ephraim<WH0669> feedeth<WH07462><WTH8802> on wind<WH07307>, and followeth<WH07291><WTH8802> after the east wind<WH06921>: he daily<WH03117> increaseth<WH07235><WTH8686> lies<WH03577> and desolation<WH07701>; and they do make<WH03772><WTH8799> a covenant<WH01285> with the Assyrians<WH0804>, and oil<WH08081> is carried<WH02986><WTH8714> into Egypt<WH04714>.

The LORD<WH03068> hath also a controversy<WH07379> with Judah<WH03063>, and will punish<WH06485><WTH8800> Jacob<WH03290> according to his ways<WH01870>; according to his doings<WH04611> will he recompense<WH07725><WTH8686> him. <RF>punish: Heb. visit upon<Rf>

He took his brother<WH0251> by the heel<WH06117><WTH8804> in the womb<WH0990>, and by his strength<WH0202> he had power<WH08280><WTH8804> with God<WH0430>: <RF>had...: Heb. was a prince, or, behaved himself princely<Rf>

Yea, he had power<WH07786><WTH8799> over the angel<WH04397>, and prevailed<WH03201><WTH8799>: he wept<WH01058><WTH8804>, and made supplication<WH02603><WTH8691> unto him: he found<WH04672><WTH8799> him <FI>in<Fi> Bethel<WH01008>, and there he spake<WH01696><WTH8762> with us;
Even the LORD<WH03068> God<WH0430> of hosts<WH06635>; the LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi> his memorial<WH02143>.
Therefore turn<WH07725><WTH8799> thou to thy God<WH0430>: keep<WH08104><WTH8798> mercy<WH02617> and judgment<WH04941>, and wait<WH06960><WTH8761> on thy God<WH0430> continually<WH08548>.<CM>

<FI> He is<Fi> a merchant<WH03667>, the balances<WH03976> of deceit<WH04820> <FI>are<Fi> in his hand<WH03027>: he loveth<WH0157><WTH8804> to oppress<WH06231><WTH8800>. <RF>a merchant: or, Canaan<Rf> <RF>oppress: or, deceive<Rf>

And Ephraim<WH0669> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Yet I am become rich<WH06238><WTH8804>, I have found me out<WH04672><WTH8804> substance<WH0202>: <FI>in<Fi> all my labours<WH03018> they shall find<WH04672><WTH8799> none iniquity<WH05771> in me that <FI>were<Fi>  sin<WH02399>. <RF>in all...: or, all my labours suffice me not: he shall have punishment of iniquity in whom is sin<Rf> <RF>that: Heb. which<Rf>

And I <FI>that am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> from the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714> will yet make thee to dwell<WH03427><WTH8686> in tabernacles<WH0168>, as in the days<WH03117> of the solemn feast<WH04150>.

I have also spoken<WH01696><WTH8765> by the prophets<WH05030>, and I have multiplied<WH07235><WTH8689> visions<WH02377>, and used similitudes<WH01819><WTH8762>, by the ministry<WH03027> of the prophets<WH05030>. <RF>ministry: Heb. hand<Rf>

<FI> Is there<Fi> iniquity<WH0205> <FI>in<Fi> Gilead<WH01568>? surely they are vanity<WH07723>: they sacrifice<WH02076><WTH8765> bullocks<WH07794> in Gilgal<WH01537>; yea, their altars<WH04196> <FI>are<Fi>  as heaps<WH01530> in the furrows<WH08525> of the fields<WH07704>.

And Jacob<WH03290> fled<WH01272><WTH8799> into the country<WH07704> of Syria<WH0758>, and Israel<WH03478> served<WH05647><WTH8799> for a wife<WH0802>, and for a wife<WH0802> he kept<WH08104><WTH8804> <FI>sheep<Fi> .
And by a prophet<WH05030> the LORD<WH03068> brought<WH05927><WTH8689> Israel<WH03478> out of Egypt<WH04714>, and by a prophet<WH05030> was he preserved<WH08104><WTH8738>.

Ephraim<WH0669> provoked <FI>him<Fi> to anger<WH03707><WTH8689> most bitterly<WH08563>: therefore shall he leave<WH05203><WTH8799> his blood<WH01818> upon him, and his reproach<WH02781> shall his Lord<WH0113> return<WH07725><WTH8686> unto him. <RF>most...: Heb. with bitternesses<Rf> <RF>blood: Heb. bloods<Rf><CM>
